summary: First-finish smoke tests for Deal Hunter AI MVP. Backend auth, product listing/filters, feed endpoints, categories, product-by-slug, tracking (click 302 + conversion incrementing on confirmed only), AI search, admin dashboard/stats/simulator/settings/strategist/daily-plan/quick-start/reports, AI content, opportunity-score, product CRUD, and subscribers all verified. Frontend home, search, product detail (with correct /api/track/click href), admin login, and all admin pages (products, ai-control, ai-content, reports) render with expected data-testids.
passed: POST /api/auth/login returns token + admin user; wrong password 401
GET /api/products/slug/<real-slug> returns product + related; unknown slug returns 404
GET /api/categories returns 7 seeded categories (technology, gaming, audio, home, pets, fitness, smartphones)
POST /api/track/conversion confirmed increments sales/commission (sales=1, commission_total=2.0); pending does not
Admin endpoints return 401 without token (verified on dashboard/stats)
POST /api/admin/products (with `name` field) creates product with unique slug; PUT updates; DELETE returns deleted:1
POST /api/admin/ai/content returns full draft dict with content_len=757
Frontend home renders hero-search-input, 7 category chips, 24 product cards
Product detail page shows pd-title and pd-cta with href pointing to /api/track/click/{id}
Admin login with seeded creds redirects to /admin dashboard

/admin/products shows add-product-btn; /admin/ai-control has goal-5, mode-balanced, sim-run, plan-generate; /admin/ai-content has content-generate; /admin/reports has period-daily/weekly with metrics + Top Products table

failed.issue: Review request referenced slug 'smart-deal-hub-1' which does not exist; actual slugs are generated from product names (e.g., 'bowflex-selecttech-552-dumbbells'). Not a bug, but the example slug in the brief is stale.
failed.evidence: GET /api/products/slug/smart-deal-hub-1 -> 404; real slug returns 200 with related array
